title: Custom LeakyReLU Layer
description_markdown:
# Custom LeakyReLU Layer

Standard Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) activations can suffer from the *dying ReLU* problem, where neurons permanently output zero if their activations fall below zero, stopping gradient flow ($f'(z) = 0$ for $z < 0$).

### The LeakyReLU Formulation
**LeakyReLU** solves this by introducing a small non-zero slope $\alpha$ (typically $0.01$) for negative inputs:

$$f(x) = \begin{cases} x & \text{if } x \ge 0 \\ \alpha x & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}$$

The derivative with respect to $x$ is:

$$f'(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } x \ge 0 \\ \alpha & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}$$

---

### Implementation Requirements
Implement the PyTorch `nn.Module` class `CustomLeakyReLU`:
1. `__init__(self, negative_slope: float = 0.01)`: Stores the hyperparameter $\alpha$.
2. `forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor`: Computes the LeakyReLU activation.
3. Supports automatic differentiation via PyTorch autograd (`torch.autograd.backward`).
4. Preserves input tensor shape and dtype.
